metadataRaw.title: Quickly Improve Circulation to the Hands and Fingers
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to quickly improve blood flow and circulations to the hands and fingers.

This exercise is great for relieving stiffness and aches (especially due to hand arthritis) and promoting faster healing for injuries. All that is required is a towel.

Let us know how it works for you!
